test_title: PYST 38: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A sum at simple interest of 7% per annum amounts to Rs. 4,368 in 8 years. Find the sum.
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = Rs. 4368

Rate = 7%

Time = 8 years

**Formula used:**

Amount = Simple Interest + Principle

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Amount = (P × R × T)/100 + P

⇒ 4368 = P[(7 × 8)/100 + 1]

⇒ 4368 = P[56/100 + 1]

⇒ 4368 = P[0.56 + 1]

⇒ 4368 = P[1.56]

⇒ P = 4368/1.56 = Rs. 2800

**∴ The sum value is Rs. 2800.**
